_comment: ONE fixture set, read by src/lib/__tests__/entitySlug.test.ts (TypeScript)
and scripts/test_entity_identity.py (Python). The two implementations are
duplicated on purpose - the writer is Python and the reader is TypeScript -
so the only thing keeping them honest is that both are asserted here.
Every name below is printed verbatim somewhere in DOL's disclosure files.
keys: FRAGOMEN, DEL REY, BERNSEN & LOEWY, LLP
Fragomen, Del Rey, Bernsen Loewy, LLP
Ogletree, Deakins, Nash, Smoak & Stewart, P.C.
keys_comment: 'The Company' reduces to nothing once 'the', 'company' are stripped, so the
fallback returns the cleaned string rather than an empty key - two entities
named only out of noise words must not all collapse into one.
'Ernst & Young U.S. LLP' proves the re-glue keeps a word that is not noise:
'u s' -> 'us', so it does not merge with plain 'Ernst & Young LLP'.
'AT&T' shreds to 'at' + 't' and only the lone 't' is a single letter, so
the run is one character long and the key stays 'at t services'.
must_not_merge: Law Offices of Yang & Associates, PLLC
must_not_merge_comment: Each pair was PROPOSED by an earlier, looser version of the typo rule and
is two different parties. They are the reason same-length substitutions are
refused, one-token keys are skipped, and a matching token has to carry
meaning: Hartzman/Hartman agree only on 'law' and 'firm'.
typo_merges: FRAGOMEN, DEL REY, BERNSEN & LOEWY, LLP
Fragomen, Del Rey, Bersen Loewy, LLP
LAW OFFICE OF THOMAS V. ALLEN, PLLC.
LAW OFFICES OF THOMAS V. ALLEN, PLLC.
FRAGOMEN, DEL REY, BERNSEN & LOEWY, LLP
Fragomen, Del Rey, Bernsen Lowey, LLP
typo_merges_comment: The first name in each pair is the busier spelling and must win. Every one
is an insertion, a deletion or a transposition inside a single token, with
at least one meaningful token matching exactly on both sides.
ATTORNEYS ONLY - see scripts/entity_identity.py for the measurement that
Loewy/Lowey and Byron/Bryon are five letters, which is why the transposition
floor is 5 and the insertion floor is 6. Lee/Li stays refused at three.
